legend-lake-lucerne-axenstrasse.story: curated scenic road. lake cliffs, tunnels, mountains. A one-way ride of 34 km, Luzern to Altdorf - roughly 37 min in the saddle. The highest point is about 1,800 m. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Klausen Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 5 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
